title: Credited Fee Rates on Refunded Pocketwire Business Profile Sales
content:
The credited fee percentage on a refunded sale of a Pocketwire Business Profile is the tier's micropayment rate percentage when the sale amount is below the micropayment threshold, and otherwise follows the sale channel recorded on the sale: the QR-code percentage for a QR-code sale, the tap-to-pay percentage for a tap-to-pay sale, the invoice percentage for an invoice sale, and the in-app and online-checkout percentage for an in-app or online-checkout sale.

| Refunded sale | Credited fee percentage |
|---|---|
| amount below USD 10.00, any channel | micropayment percentage |
| USD 10.00 or more, QR code | QR-code percentage |
| USD 10.00 or more, tap to pay | tap-to-pay percentage |
| USD 10.00 or more, invoice | invoice percentage |
| USD 10.00 or more, in-app or online checkout | in-app and online-checkout percentage |

## The percentages in figures

| | Starter | Essentials | Growth | Pro | Premier | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Micropayment threshold | USD 10.00 | USD 10.00 | USD 10.00 | USD 10.00 | USD 10.00 | USD 10.00 |
| Micropayment | 4.99% | 4.99% | 4.99% | 4.49% | 3.99% | 3.99% |
| QR code | 1.90% | 1.90% | 1.79% | 1.69% | 1.49% | 1.29% |
| Tap to pay | 2.60% | 2.60% | 2.50% | 2.40% | 2.29% | 2.19% |
| Invoice | 3.49% | 3.49% | 3.29% | 2.99% | 2.79% | 2.59% |
| In-app and online checkout | 2.99% | 2.69% | 2.49% | 2.29% | 1.99% | 1.79% |

Columns are the tiers Pocketwire Business Starter to Pocketwire Business Enterprise; the percentage is read from the tier the profile holds.

**Examples (hypothetical sales on Pocketwire Business Pro).** A USD 9.50 tap-to-pay sale: 4.49%. A USD 10.00 tap-to-pay sale: 2.40%. A USD 60.00 invoice sale: 2.99%.
